goal: Continue the existing active Smart Jobseeker product-development goal
boundaries: no delegation or new goal authorized by this file
preserve resource ownership and host RAM reserve
never manually close, dismiss or suppress detector findings

tasks.title: Bounded, responsive local control plane
acceptance: No slow socket monopolizes workspace state
Absolute read/write deadlines; bounded workers/queue/backpressure
Status/stop responsiveness, saturation and shutdown regression evidence

tasks.title: Versioned representative and held-out evaluation
acceptance: Private source/model/configuration-bound corpus manifest
Explicit correctness, abstention, completion and resource denominators
Held-out partition fixed before tuning; repeats for model promotion

tasks.title: Faithful permitted saved rendering and label context
acceptance: Repair eligible resource/context gaps without relaxing source or write boundaries
Required labels and controls independently visible and bound
Earlier and held-out saved cases retain honest review outcomes

tasks.title: Generic model-driven form completion
acceptance: Typed bounded planning using supported candidate facts
Custom choices, repeated histories, conditional/multistep/frame scenarios
Independent before/after visual and native checks; no-progress review fallback

tasks.title: Candidate isolation and consequential-action gates
acceptance: Fictional canary data and adversarial write-transport fixtures
OS and transport evidence independent of model/button wording
No real employer interactions beyond read-only; no application sends

tasks.title: Generic factual documents and final PDF acceptance
acceptance: Varied import/template/scanned/long/multilingual evidence
Every final attachment PDF; independent text and per-page visual review
Factual provenance, bounded repairs, exact exported attachment hashes

tasks.title: Broad discovery and real application-route verification
acceptance: Varied free provider/direct-employer queries with bounded resume/backoff
Original ads; fresh/stale/closed/inaccessible/challenge distinctions
Labeled retrieval and actual-route reachability evidence

tasks.title: Fit calibration and near-duplicate/application exclusion
acceptance: Versioned objective rubric plus supported semantic assessment
Repeatability and independently reviewed held-out examples
False merge/missed duplicate and restart/application-alias evidence

tasks.title: Validated experience reuse and lesson promotion
acceptance: Provenance, review, revisions, scope, revoke/expiry and conflicts
Paired no-memory/with-memory tests on held-out changed platforms
Promote only measured improvements without critical regressions

tasks.title: Attempt archive, email preparation and recovery
acceptance: Complete immutable packet/ad/answers/screenshots/outcome manifest
Crash/cancel/restart/ambiguous-write reconciliation without automatic retry
Email preparation/correlation; no application email sent

tasks.title: Clean Windows setup, private storage and resource acceptance
acceptance: Clean non-admin Windows missing/interrupted/offline/custom-path setup evidence
SQLCipher/DPAPI migration, backup/restore and degraded-build disclosures
Measured model/context RAM/VRAM and bounded teardown with host reserve

tasks.title: Whole-interface design and interaction acceptance
acceptance: Screen/state matrix and faithful iterative rendered design review
Mouse-drag resize bounds, real browser zoom/DPI/accessibility where available
Every setting functional and persisted; no invented status

tasks.title: Maintainability, artifact retention and efficient validation
acceptance: Refactor changed mechanisms while preserving contracts
Immutable input reuse and dry-run owned-artifact retention
Change-directed checks, short evidence handoffs and verified cleanup

tasks.title: Readiness evidence for user decision
acceptance: Exact-source supported-scope integrated acceptance evidence
Required hosted checks and visible detector states; no manual closure
Honest remaining limits; no release or application submission
